scope: Native browser timer receiver fix discovered during integrated audio verification

reportedBrowserError.location: RecordedMusic.start: calling this.setTimer with a Window host function stored directly on the instance
reportedBrowserError.source: Root task native browser observation; browser follow-up owned by root.

fix: Wrap only default setTimer and clearTimer parameters through globalThis.setTimeout/clearTimeout. Existing injected timer functions remain unchanged.
meaningfulRegression: The actual RecordedMusic transport uses default timers against Window-like global functions that throw TypeError('Illegal invocation') for any receiver other than globalThis. It starts buildA, schedules the 94.5-second tail, rotates into buildB with the original 1.5-second crossfade, clears on pause, resumes the saved offset, and clears all timers/voices/cache on disposal.
